simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פָּנִין (H6443) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פָּנִין (pânîyn) means probably a pearl (as round) First listed occurrence: Job 28 18.

definitions.full: H6443. peninim מְּנִינִים noun [feminine] plural corals (? as branching compare Arabic branch of tree; so Mich Thes and others; > pearls Bo Hieroz. 601 Di Jb after Ra and others); — ׳פ figurative of value Prov 20:15 ; usually ׳מִמּ , camp. Job 28:18 ; Prov 3:15 (Kt מפניים ), 8:11 ; 31:10 (all of value), Lam 4:7 (of red colour); + Psa 45:14 (perhaps; for מְּנִימָה , q. v. ).
definitions.rootNote: or פָּנִי ; from the same as 6434 ;
